headword: {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}

definitions.explanation: A special offer, price, or bonus available only to first-time customers or purchasers.
A special version of a product (like CDs, DVDs, or games) released in limited quantities with the initial batch, often including bonus content.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}{価格|かかく}で{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I signed up at the first-time only price.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}のお{客様|きゃくさま}は{送料|そうりょう}{無料|むりょう}です。
{初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}キャンペーンを{利用|りよう}した。
examples.english: I took advantage of the first-time only campaign.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}{盤|ばん}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I pre-ordered the limited first pressing.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}{盤|ばん}には{特典|とくてん}DVDが{付|つ}く。
examples.english: The limited first edition comes with a bonus DVD.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}{盤|ばん}はもう{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The limited first edition is already sold out.

notes:
{初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい} has two main uses: marketing offers for new customers and special first-run editions of entertainment products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}{価格|かかく} (first-time only price)
- {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}{盤|ばん} (limited first pressing/edition)
- {初回|しょかい}{限定|げんてい}{特典|とくてん} (first-edition bonus)

RELATED TERMS:
- {通常|つうじょう}{盤|ばん}: regular edition
- {数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}: limited quantity
- {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}: limited time
